intro: Paint & Pour runs guided sip-and-paint nights in Epping and Chingford, where founder Bryony takes guests through a painting step by step. No experience is needed, and every guest leaves with their finished canvas.
about: Bryony says she started Paint & Pour with a simple idea: most people haven't picked up a paintbrush since school, and they really should, preferably with a glass of wine in the other hand. Guests can come with friends, with a date or on their own.

Each night runs for three hours. Guests arrive, collect a complimentary drink and find an easel before Bryony starts them on the painting, with music playing. Canvas, paints, brushes and aprons are all provided, so guests only need to bring themselves. The evening closes with a 'Mini Gallery & Photo Time'.

Public nights take place at Carpino Lounge on Epping High Street and at The Royal Forest on Ranger's Road, Chingford. Tickets for the currently listed nights are sold through Eventbrite at £35 each; they are non-refundable, but Bryony offers a transfer to an event on another date. Doors open at 6:40pm, with check-in at 7pm and painting from 7:30pm. Under-18s must come with a parent or legal guardian.

The organiser says the events usually sell out and suggests following their Eventbrite page to hear about new dates first. Their public pages do not describe private or exclusive bookings, so anyone planning a group occasion should ask them directly, through Eventbrite or Instagram, about availability and format.

services.name: Paint & Pour Night, Epping
services.description: A three-hour guided sip-and-paint evening at Carpino Lounge, 183 High Street, Epping. It includes a complimentary drink on arrival, all supplies and step-by-step instruction from Bryony. Tickets for the listed dates are £35.

services.name: Paint & Pour Night, Chingford
services.description: The same guided evening at The Royal Forest, Ranger's Road, Chingford (E4 7QH). It includes a drink on arrival, all painting supplies and step-by-step teaching. Tickets for the listed dates are £35.

services.name: Beginner-friendly tuition
services.description: No experience is needed. Guests are taken through one painting a step at a time, with music on and room to go off-piste. As the organiser puts it, wobbly lines are part of the fun.

services.name: Materials and a take-home canvas
services.description: Canvas, paints, brushes and aprons are all provided, so guests only need to bring themselves. Evenings finish with a 'Mini Gallery & Photo Time', and everyone takes their painting home.

identity.note: Paint & Pour has no website of its own and trades through an Eventbrite organiser account in its founder's name and an Instagram account; an older, unverified directory listing gives a 2015 start date and an Epping High Street address, neither of which appears on the business's own pages.
